servingHtml:
Serving Lewisville

We handle HVAC projects throughout Lewisville’s lakeside properties, established neighborhoods, and commercial districts. Our NATE-certified technicians provide expert heating and cooling solutions for this diverse community’s homes and businesses.

Lewisville Fun Fact: The “Most Southwestern City in the United States,” Lewisville sits on two lakes and is home to the historic MCL Grand Theater, entertaining audiences since 1947!
reviewsHtml:
Customer Reviews

See what our satisfied Lewisville customers say with over 400 five-star ratings as Little Elm’s top HVAC contractor. Read our reviews to learn why families throughout Lewisville, TX trust Air Zone Experts.

items.q: What HVAC repairs and installs are offered in the Lewisville area?
items.a: In Lewisville, we handle the complete range: air conditioning repair, replacement and installation, air duct work, and heating service — furnace repair, heater replacement, heater installation — with 24/7 emergency coverage.

items.q: Is emergency AC service available at night in Lewisville right now?
items.a: Yes, day or night. Our emergency HVAC service runs 24/7 no matter where in Lewisville you’re located.

items.q: How much should I expect to pay for AC repair in the Lewisville area?
items.a: We never guess at a price — a technician examines the system, then presents a clear cost. Nothing starts until you say go, and there are no hidden fees added after the fact.

items.q: Are HVAC contractors required to be licensed and insured in the Lewisville area?
items.a: Yes — it’s the law in Texas. HVAC contractors must hold a TDLR-issued license and insurance. Air Zone Experts satisfies both requirements, and owner Adrian Racovei also holds NATE and EPA Section 608 certifications.

items.q: Since when has your company served the Lewisville community?
items.a: Family-owned and veteran-owned since 2008, serving Lewisville since well before it became one of the area’s largest lakeside cities.

items.q: Does Air Zone Experts have strong customer reviews in the Lewisville area?
items.a: Yes, on both counts — family-owned and veteran-owned, and it’s part of why 85% of our business comes from referrals, alongside 400+ five-star reviews.

items.q: Can you service HVAC systems in Old Town Lewisville's buildings from the 1880s as well as newer neighborhoods like Castle Hills?
items.a: Yes. Old Town’s century-old structures and newer neighborhoods like Castle Hills and Vista Ridge each need different HVAC expertise, and we handle both correctly.

items.q: What's the recommended service schedule in Lewisville throughout the year?
items.a: Two visits a year does it — spring for cooling season, fall for heating season, keeping both systems ready.

items.q: Will my HVAC repair be finished in one visit once a technician arrives?
items.a: In most cases, yes — one visit is enough, usually within a few hours. Rare cases requiring special-order parts take longer, but we’ll flag that immediately so there are no surprises.

items.q: Do you serve neighborhoods near Lewisville Lake and along I-35E?
items.a: Yes. Both the lakefront neighborhoods and the I-35E corridor are within our standard Lewisville service area.

items.q: How fast can an HVAC company respond in Lewisville if I call this morning?
items.a: Same-day is the goal for most calls. An early call gives us the best shot at resolving things the same day you reach out.

items.q: What HVAC equipment brands are recommended for the Lewisville climate?
items.a: Trane is where our authorized-dealer expertise lives, and our day-to-day work still spans all the major brands homeowners already have.
